name: Viper Scale Armor
body:
Aura: moderate necromancy and transmutation; CL 7th; Slot: chest; Price: 6,000 gp, Weight: 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This armor is made from the scales of huge vipers. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus on saves vs. poison and a +2 enhancement bonus to Stealth, Intimidate and Perception checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells delay poison, invisibility, silence; Cost: 3,000 gp.
